subject: boxplots - request for change in next version

messages.author: 930dbf41faaa4708
messages.subject: boxplots - request for change in next version
parts:
Hadley,

In a conversation about boxplots yesterday, I realized something about the implementation in ggplot2. The median line is the same width as all of the other lines - it should be thicker. The primary comparison that people need to make between distributions is based on the medians of the groups, then the spread which is the box. And outliers are somewhat separate piece of information - you already have the ability to increase the focus on outliers if desired.

Can you increase the line width for the median and make this the default? Or at least allow the thickness of this line to be changed.

cheers,
Di
---------------------------
Dianne Cook
dic...@iastate.edu

messages.subject: Re: boxplots - request for change in next version
parts:
Hi Di,

Good point. In the next version, you can use the fatten argument to
control how much fatter the median line is compared to the other two
lines.

I've also simplified the boxplot drawing code so it should be easier
to add similar features in the future.

Hadley
